title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Settlement Amount Under Each Liability Yardstick
content:
The amount at which a claim under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` is settled depends first on the yardstick the claim's tier uses to measure the line's liability.

## Scope

This statement governs the settlement of every kind of loss except delay loss. A delay loss is settled under its own delay ceilings.

## Statement

Before any annual aggregate is considered, the settlement of an admissible claim is:

- under **Hague-Visby limitation**, the proven loss or the Hague-Visby limit, whichever is lower;
- under **declared value**, the proven loss or the declared value share of the affected packages, whichever is lower;
- under **CargoCare cover**, the CargoCare amount for the container claimed.

The yardstick is the one attached to the tier recorded on the claim's cover. Exactly one of the three lines applies to any claim, because every tier has exactly one yardstick.

## Truth table (hypothetical figures)

| Yardstick of the tier | Proven loss (USD) | Ceiling particular to the yardstick (USD) | Settlement before any aggregate (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hague-Visby limitation | 7200.00 | Hague-Visby limit 10708.05 | 7200.00 |
| Hague-Visby limitation | 14000.00 | Hague-Visby limit 10708.05 | 10708.05 |
| declared value | 5300.00 | declared value share 4800.00 | 4800.00 |
| CargoCare cover | 7200.00 | CargoCare amount 7820.00 | 7820.00 |

Under CargoCare cover the settlement is the CargoCare amount itself, and that amount can exceed the proven loss where the tier applies a valuation uplift.
